title: 教育課程論（春期集中講義）
subtitle: Curriculum Theory
keywords: Modernization of the Content in Education
educationalGoal: At present, school education in Japan is at a tipping point, with the current curriculum guidelines increasing class hours. Curriculum defines the content and method of school education, and is directly related to the basic tone of school education. In this course, we will discuss historical changes inside and outside the curriculum, and we will consider the ideal curriculum for school education in the future while keeping the organization principle in mind.
advice:
This course covers the items as below.
 1. The Course of Study and curriculum
 2. Principles of the curriculum
 3. History of curriculum reform
 4. The objectives and the contents of “The Period for Integrated Studies”
 5. The future curriculum
books: Atarashii Jidai no Kyouiku-Katei(4th ed.), Yuhikaku (Curriculum in the New Era.)
requiredKnowledge: This course is for those who are serious about becoming a teacher.

              At present, school education in Japan is at a tipping point, with the current curriculum guidelines increasing class hours. Curriculum defines the content and method of school education, and is directly related to the basic tone of school education. In this course, we will discuss historical changes inside and outside the curriculum, and we will consider the ideal curriculum for school education in the future while keeping the organization principle in mind.

              授業の概要および学習上の助言

 1. The Course of Study and curriculum
 2. Principles of the curriculum
 3. History of curriculum reform

 5. The future curriculum
